fields.quote: Scores are averaged across all 5 random seeds of the best hyperparameter setting, evaluated on the development set.
fields.reason: The main table only compares X-MOD and SHARED, both pre-trained by the authors on the same 60 languages for 265k steps, and the caption states those scores come from their own seed-averaged evaluation under one hyperparameter protocol. That is a same-harness rerun of the comparator, not an unreproduced external number.

claims.quote: Pre-trained language results for the modular and shared model variants, pre-trained on the set of 60 languages for 265k update steps.
claims.reason: This is the authors' own ARCH claim (language-specific modules pre-trained from the start). Table 2 is a with-vs-without comparison at matched languages and update steps, with per-language trainable parameters held constant by design; the extra stored modules are the ablated element, not a separate size/data confound.
